outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: refined art direction sheet for TWO bacterial enemies in an existing 2D microscopy game. Image 1 is the previous concept reference: preserve ONLY the accepted olive motile bacterium and gray-teal encapsulated bacterium design language, completely omit the robot. Refine toward translucent microscopic material rather than watercolor paper or shiny 3D. Wide landscape sheet, warm pale peach #f2e2da flat background, no text or labels. Two equal columns: left motile bacterium, right encapsulated bacterium. Top half: one large detail view of each, orthographic directly overhead. Bottom half: a smaller row in each column with three versions demonstrating normal, mildly squeezed, mildly bent SOFT-BODY outlines of that same bacterium; delicate bodies remain coherent and smooth, no extreme collapse. Motile body: short rounded rod, aspect ratio only 1.6:1, subtly asymmetric, restrained yellow-olive and sage material, softly grouped irregular fine granules distributed throughout with a few pale patches, no central nucleus, no luminous center, no large bubble circles. TWO thin flagella attached to one end, tapered, asymmetric traveling-wave shapes, no branching and no hairs all over body. Each tail about one body length, delicate muted olive. Encapsulated bacterium: plump near-round gray teal inner body, same family of finely mottled cytoplasmic material, no central nucleus, surrounding transparent hydrated capsule about 12 percent of body radius in thickness, cool off-white gray rim with irregular softly fading edge. Capsule follows every deformation of the body, no hard concentric rings, no thick cotton-cloud outer coat, no spikes, NO flagella on this species. Top studies equally magnified to compare material; lower small samples clearly retain distinguishing silhouette and membrane. Flat transmitted light, microphotography-inspired fine-grained texture, low saturation but enough local contrast for game readability. No shadows, no specular balls, no background paper grain, no extra cells/species, no robot, no UI, no annotations. This is a conceptual game-art sheet, not medical evidence and not a real engine screenshot.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production candidate full-bleed square cytoplasm texture for a small soft-body bacterium in a 2D microscopy game. Image 1 is a STYLE/COLOR reference only: use the interior material of the LEFT olive-green bacterium. Produce ONLY an unbounded square field of that material, filling the entire canvas including all four corners, 100% opaque. No bacterium silhouette, NO membrane, NO border, NO flagella, NO capsule, NO background, NO text, NO diagrams. The game will clip and deform this texture using its own mesh; any baked silhouette would be wrong. Fine translucent-looking muted olive/sage cytoplasm with pale yellow-green regions and moderate irregular darker olive clusters. Broad softly blended mottling at 6-10 patches across the square, with sparse very fine granules embedded into the material. Preserve readable mid-scale value variation when the texture is reduced to 20-40 screen pixels. Avoid pronounced bubble outlines, large individual organelles, nucleus, central dark spot, central bright gradient, vignette, gloss, directional light, brush strokes, watercolor paper, photographic background. Uniform lighting, quiet natural microphotographic texture, enough pigment for differentiation from pale pink vessel lumen. Material should continue through all edges, no visible seams or decorative framing. This is an artistic texture, not a real microscopy photograph.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production candidate full-bleed square cytoplasm texture for the encapsulated bacterium in a 2D microscopy game. Image 1 is STYLE/COLOR reference only: use the interior material of the RIGHT gray-teal encapsulated bacterium, never its surrounding white capsule. Produce ONLY an unbounded square field of interior cytoplasm material, fill every corner, fully opaque. The game clips this with a deforming mesh and draws the capsule separately. NO circular silhouette, NO capsule, NO membrane, NO edge, NO background, NO flagella, NO central nucleus, NO text. Restrained sage-blue/gray-teal translucent-looking cytoplasm, irregular soft gray-green patches with a little warm ivory variation and scattered small muted ochre granules. Mid-tone body must remain visible on a pale peach background at a 24-48 pixel diameter. Broad irregular pigment clusters at roughly 6-10 patches across the square, subordinate fine microphotographic grain, no regular pattern. Uniform transmitted lighting, no central glow, no vignette, no spherical shading, no droplets, no giant bubbles, no jewelry, no brush marks, no watercolor paper. Match the organic quiet material of the concept while strengthening mid-scale mottling slightly for small in-game use. Seamless-looking continuation through all edges. Artistic game texture, not a real micrograph.
